description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [Imperil Ice 20% (15s)], grants [Buff Ice 20% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Reynn], [With Wishes in Mind Damage Tracker], and [With Wishes in Mind Level] to the user

description.name: Buff Ice 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Reynn
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Wish Wishes in Mind (0~2), removed after using With Wishes in Mind two times

description.name: With Wishes in Mind Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases With Wishes in Mind level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Reynn]

description.name: With Wishes in Mind Level
description.text: Keeps track of With Wishes in Mind level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Reynn]
